title: Campagne Romane: Roman Countryside Dinner
description: Osteria Iotto cooks with produce from Matilde Coltiva, paired with Gazzetta wines, for an evening celebrating the Roman countryside at Vinificio; reservations via DM or the link in bio.

title: Alfonso&Pedrajo x Para Compartir
description: A collaboration evening with the Alfonso&Pedrajo winery at Para Compartir in Rome, with reservations required by phone.

title: Bortolotti Valdobbiadene Sparkling Wine Dinner
description: A dinner at Sacro featuring sparkling wines from Bortolotti Valdobbiadene, with limited seats so booking is recommended.

title: Arnaldo Rossi Wine Tasting
description: Tuscan winemaker and innkeeper Arnaldo Rossi shares a selection of authentic bottles, paired with quick dishes served at the bar.

title: Slargo w/ Sciccherie & (Coccio) Food + Gifts
description: An evening at Slargo with tasty bites by Sciccherie, a ceramics market and live performance by Coccio.lab, plus gifts.

title: Troppo Frizzante feat. Cantina Ribelà
description: A wine and vinyl evening at Semi di Vino with Cantina Ribelà's wines, a vinyl DJ set, and the restaurant's dishes.

title: Hi-Fi Nation - Ep.02
description: The second Hi-Fi Nation sound system night in Rome, featuring a line-up of Italian artists, running from 19:00 until closing at Frissón.

title: Thanksgiving Dinner at Run by Nuns
description: A Thanksgiving feast by reservation only, with turkey and sage stuffing, roasted Camembert, autumn vegetables, pie, and wine.

title: Sbicchierata N.18
description: A guided blind tasting of five wines at Cecafumo Vineria, the 18th edition of the Sbicchierata, for 20 euros per person with mandatory reservation.

title: Window Crew Indoor Edition: DJ set by Bea
description: Bea spins a selection of punk from 1978, 1980s new wave and Sixties sounds at La Berta, closing Window Crew's November lineup.

title: Il Guercio Vertical Tasting with Sean O'Callaghan
description: A vertical tasting of all eight vintages of Il Guercio di Tenuta di Carleone, from 2017 to 2024, presented by winemaker Sean O'Callaghan, with a four-course menu designed for the evening (130 € per person, reservations required).

title: Lopez e Strina - Soul and Blues
description: Soul and blues live performance by Lopez e Strina, with table reservations available through the venue's website.

title: Arnaud and Friends
description: A weekly Friday lunch at Rori with hot slices, where groups of 4 or more can book a table on the website.

title: RUVIDO goes to BARRO
description: Ruvido brings its kitchen to Barro's food store in Via Carlo Pisacane 14, with Barro pouring the wine and Ruvido serving an à la carte menu.

title: Listening Session: John Coltrane, A Love Supreme
description: A full-album listening session of John Coltrane's A Love Supreme, guided by Federico Zanghì, marking the centenary of Coltrane's birth.

title: Louis Arnaud Jose x Vetro: Une soirée d'enfer
description: A fiery evening at Vetro with Louis Arnaud Jose cooking over the flames; reservations are required and made via the link in bio.

title: Beaujolais Nouveau Festival with DJ Set by Valerio Moscatelli
description: A weekend celebrating Beaujolais Nouveau, with a preview at Enoteca Il Piccolo on Friday 27 and a festival with a DJ set by Valerio Moscatelli at Bar Sogno on Saturday 28.

title: Tu Sei Balera: Sunday lunch with DJ set and burraco
description: A relaxed Sunday lunch for the over-60s at La Berta, with traditional dishes, old-school dance music, a burraco tournament, prizes and a cotillion, free entry and no reservation needed (burraco requires booking).

title: Dal Conero alla Cina
description: A themed lunch at Sorso bar in Rome, hosted by Andrea Sciamanna, with a menu that travels from the Conero coast to China. Reservations are by DM.

title: La Mescita 15th Anniversary
description: A full-day celebration of La Mescita's 15 years with wines from an emerging Gradoli winery, Forno Bianchi sandwiches, and DJ sets from 15:00 to 22:00, with no reservations needed.

title: Pierre Beauger Bottle Opening at Folderol Faidherbe
description: Pierre Beauger opens bottles at Folderol Faidherbe in Paris, paired with Rigmarole pasta, with free entry for consumers and a tasting from 16:00 to 20:00.

title: ZERO ZERO OFF
description: A Sunday afternoon event at Sospeso featuring Domaine de la Petit Soeur, Les Maisons Brulees, Officina Consenso, and DJ set by Filippo Loy.

title: Dumpling Party
description: A dumpling night at Vinificio with food from the Dumpling Bar Roma kitchen and a selection of champagne served by the glass, starting at 7pm.

title: Pizza, Trippa & Rock'n'Roll: four-hands dinner Santini x Glory Pop
description: A four-hands tasting dinner at Santini in Rome, where the kitchens of Santini and Glory Pop Milano alternate courses across a menu built around pizza in all its forms.

title: Working Film – Laboratorio Popolare di Cinema
description: An open people's film workshop at La Berta where anyone can pitch an unmade film idea, held every other Monday with guests including Hleb Papou and Phaim Bhuiyan on November 30 and Leonardo D'Agostini and Maria Tilli on December 14.

title: Degustazioni dal Basso: Piero Macciocca (La Visciola)
description: A tasting with winemaker Piero Macciocca of La Visciola in Piglio, who will share his story and pour his wines and the wines that shaped his path, at 90 euros per person with limited, booking-only seats.

title: Is Protesting Still a Right?
description: A public talk at La Berta in Rome on the state of the right to protest in Italy, with Paola Bevere (HUB4DEFENDERS), Camilla Siliotti (A Buon Diritto), Stefania N'Kombo José Teresa (Lunaria), moderated by journalist Annalisa Camilli.

title: December Live Music Lineup
description: A monthly live music series with a different musician every Thursday in December, starting with Marta dell'Anno e il suo gruppo on December 3, followed by Ljuba de Angelis Ensemble on December 10 and Sam Ghezzi on December 17.

title: Testaccio Comedy Night Vol.3
description: Stand-up comedy night at Vinificio with Angelo Ritrovato (host), Cecilia Forastieri, Pietro Maccabei, Federica Gambino, Francesco Picchio and Angelo Curci; free entry, but table reservations are recommended.

title: Il pane e il Celio: seven bruschette for seven hills
description: Eroi della Pizza's bread heads to Casina del Salvi on the Celio for a lunch with seven bruschette, one for each of Rome's seven hills, plus a glass of wine, served until 4 PM.

title: Panettone Tasting Day with Lievitati Lenti & 33Giri
description: A relaxed Sunday at 33Giri with three artisanal panettoni to taste, a savory surprise, records by Carlo Scordo, and panettoni available to take home.

title: Brunch della Madonna
description: A special walk-in brunch (no reservations needed) from 11:30 to 15:00, with small plates, wine, spritz, and the bakery's breads and cakes.
